title: Minimal Luxury lab 3 (source of the round-3 templates)
summary: The 8 comps the round-3 Minimal Luxury templates were built and verified in: material swatches, property feature (masked photo window), collection index, fragrance notes, save the date, boutique address, limited edition number (masked rise) and editorial spread (feathered photo window).
use_when: You want to see a round-3 luxury template working before using it, copy a comp's objects into a luxury film, or re-extract a template with comp_to_template.py after changing its copy.

comps: ML Property feature (180 f, mask window)
ML Limited edition (150 f, mask window)
ML Editorial spread (180 f, feathered mask window)

parameters: text content (sample copy: names, places and numbers are invented)
the lists in minimal_luxury_lab3.py (SWATCHES, LOOKS, NOTES)
carvercat_version: built and verified in Carvercat 0.1.6 (rev 1105,; public release binary, headless; pack added to the bundled Library for the test), 2026-10-28
copy_notes: No media; nothing to relink. The two photos are gradient rectangles standing in for real photos.
Each comp has a 'Lab bg' rectangle; templates are extracted with --drop "Lab bg".
Clip ids are unique per comp (msw_, mpy_, mci_, mfn_, miv_, mba_, mle_, mes_).

Rebuild: ai/scripts/motion/minimal_luxury_lab3.py; every move is baked as keys, no presets to apply; open the file, run mask.make {ids:[window, content]} + parent.clear for the three MASKS pairs, then edit.save.
Lint: every comp 0 errors / 0 warnings (ML Collection index has 8 notes: held opacity before the dim, intended).
source: Carvercat team, built with an AI agent, 2026-10-28
